podcast.title: Collaborated with Beyoncé at CMA Awards (2016)
podcast.body: The country trio The Chicks joined Beyoncé for her performance of the "Texas celebrating country and western indebted" song "Daddy Lessons" at the 2016 CMA Awards. This performance was a notable moment in the conversation surrounding the history of the black cowboy and the cross-pollination of genres. "Beyoncé who was joined by country trio The Chicks to perform her Texas celebrating country and western indebted daddy lessons."

podcast.title: The "Dixie Chick Theory" for Decline of Protest Songs
podcast.body: In March 2003, at a concert in London, Natalie Maines, the lead singer, stated that the band was ashamed that President George Bush was from Texas, in response to the invasion of Iraq. Within a week, country radio stations banned their music, and nearly 20 years later, many people have not forgiven Maines for her comments, contributing to a theory about why protest songs have ceased to be hits.
